steps.text: Stitch opens his eyes, and sees two familiar figures.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Avdotya, I've got your fresh change of clothes here.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Also, Croque, drink a little less in future, to be on the safe side.

steps.name: Croque Diamondface
steps.text: Ahahah, sorry, sorry. All's well that ends well, though, wouldn't you say?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: No, I still don't see anything 'well' about this...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: In the meantime, I suppose I'll find somewhere to change.
With that, the two of them notice Stitch has come to.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: *sigh* Good morning, Stitch.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: What happened to me?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Do you still remember how you fainted?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: I was steering the boat, and then old Edge came running over, and then... oof, my head...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And then the boat went out of control, crashed against the shore, and flung the two of you out.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: And how about Master Edge?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: He woke up before you, and he's taken Elysium with him to survey for now.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Wait, the gear on the boat!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: The equipment's all essentially wrecked. As for the survey gear... we had Deculture make that on the fly.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: The cutting equipment won't be necessary, though.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: You didn't notice the terribly loud noise ever since you woke up?
Avdotya flashes a begrudging glance at a place too not far off.
And with her prompting, it finally hits Stitch that the persistent racket isn't just nature. Is that a mixture of a chainsaw's roar and collapsing rock?

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: Gavial, what in your right mind are you doing...?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks obvious to me. I'm sorting out this cliff face.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: The boat did put a considerable dent in the caved-in area, but clearing a passage was never going to be that simple.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And with our cutting equipment down, I thought we'd be waiting for a while, but it turns out—

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Well, seeing is believing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: HAHA! Forget rail repairs and surveys, any bozo can tell THIS is my strong suit!
Gazing all around, Stitch sees numerous fragments of extremely orderly cut rock, as well as a tunnel wide enough to fit two side by side.
The fine work of Gavial, without a doubt.
Which is to say, deprived of all the cutting equipment, Gavial opened a way through to the tunnel all by her singular self.
Stitch can't help but begin to suspect that the rumors he heard from the Acahuallan tribes, all those legends of the invincible Gavial, were at least partly founded in reality.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, hey, Elysium. How come you're back so soon?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What happened? Where's Master Edge?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Things have gone a little south, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? You mean some giant Originium slug showed up, or what? I heard Provence saw something like that in Siesta.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: If it was just some creature, I guarantee I'd be happy to wisecrack with you right now.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Follow me.
After having drilled through the cave-in, everyone enters the tunnel itself.
The space inside is more of a cave than a tunnel in reality, both vast and profoundly deep.
Nevertheless, Elysium is more than up to the task, and everyone proceeds through smoothly with him leading the way.
So smoothly, in fact, that it piques their curiosities that he could grasp the tunnel's structure in such a short time; there's even suspicion he's been this way before.
However, that idea, more a joke than anything, pales in comparison to the hesitance at the sight that greets them where Elysium comes to a halt.
It is a vein of Originium, exposed on the surface of the strata.
Moreover, anyone with some knowledge of Originium could easily tell that this vein has been active for a very, very long time.
And activity means—
Explosion.
Or put less kindly—
Disaster.

steps.name: Stitch Canvas
steps.text: How can this be?!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We'd detected the presence of Originium veins in this direction back in the city's founding times, but they should've been much further out—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Is there any chance the earthquake pulled them here? I heard about a few small aftershocks in the wake.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The suddenness of this vein definitely matches, after all.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: It's not impossible...

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Right, that's it! Chances are that earthquake shifted it right over here!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: And what's more, it gave it that push, got its activity slowly warming up.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: And because the dome's Originium sensor facilities have been down all this time, that's why we only just now found this out—

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Stitch, calm now. This isn't your fault.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We made this decision as the collective inhabitants of Zeruertza.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Thing's just...

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We haven't gone even a half kilometer from outside, I'd wager. If a full vein of active Originium explodes only that deep in...

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Then Zeruertza's out of luck.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Attention all residents of Zeruertza, we interrupt this broadcast with an urgent notice.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Following the conclusion of our swimming competition prior, Master Edge has taken the initiative in leading a selection of other contestants through the cave-in to survey the tunnel.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: The results of this survey are not optimistic.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Master Edge has discovered an Originium vein in the tunnel, located approximately one kilometer from the city.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: We tentatively speculate this Originium vein's existence was known at the time of Zeruertza's founding, in a stratum approximately three kilometers out.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: However, tectonic shift originating in the earthquake half a year ago caused this vein to warp and extend closer to our city, and kickstarted its activation in the process.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Currently, Master Edge is leading experts to urgently evaluate this Originium vein's level of activity, and thus determine at what point in the future it will explode.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: We will provide further updates once accurate conclusions can be drawn.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: As of now, we ask all residents to be prepared to evacuate.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Huh? An active Originium vein's going to explode? Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: Judging by the broadcast, we never picked it up after the earthquake wrecked the dome, since the Originium sensor functions never got fixed since.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Now that you mention, I'm pretty sure I've heard Master Edge make mention of the sort.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Well, nothing to do about it now, such as it is.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Don't you... feel as though it was a poor decision to build 'The Great Aquapit?'

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: What for? It's an outcome we're willing to take.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: True, that. We've never rejected any of the naysay from Master Edge.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: He warned as much when we decided to build this 'Great Aquapit' instead of repairing that hole in the dome.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: And we only made that decision once we understood and accepted the potential danger.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: All it is now is taking responsibility for the outcome of our choice.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: So it is, surface-dweller. You don't need to give us any pity.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Think about it this way: we've spent a good long summer at least, haven't we?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: I completely agree.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Though, evacuating, eh... Haven't decided what I'm going to leave behind. Have you?

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: I'm nothing like you are. If you ask me right now, my house here's my most wanted and most satisfying design yet.

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: That's fair. I hope that Originium vein's not going off too easily. I still need to think a little.

steps.name: Cool-Headed Durin
steps.text: How about we go for a drink for now? Some Old Karl Mead?

steps.name: Indolent Durin
steps.text: Not my poison. I'll rather be having a No. 7 Whiskey.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'd taken Durins to all be buffoons barely smarter than the Archosauria above them... It seems that was hardly the case.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: What's the outlook, Master Edge?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We'll need a little more time to be sure, but based on my experience—

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: It'll go off within a month.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: A month?

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Then we should lay the railway while we have the chance, and arrange to evacuate the residents through the tunnel.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Not a chance. Not enough time.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Much more feasible if we dig a temporary shelter deeper in.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: We're all aware the dome might be able to suppress some of the vein's explosive force, should it go off.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But the real issue is the Originium dust scattering afterwards!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Once it happens, that dust will fill this entire space, and all of us will be affected by it!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: We have to repair the railway despite any danger at this point, and then we clear any obstructions and have everyone take refuge in Ortzimuga!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: But the tunnel's already wall to wall with Originium now! It'll be a nightmare to pass through safely!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Zeruertza's home to hundreds of thousands! Do you not understand how much time it'll take to feed them carefully through that tunnel? It's two by two at most in there, you realize that?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey... cool the quibbling.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Gavial, I'll get to you in a moment. Master Edge, do you honestly have a better plan?

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: I believe we should begin immediately digging away from the Originium vein.

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: We dig a small-scale shelter, big enough to hold everyone, then we seal off the way to it. It's just a question of digging deep enough...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: It'll be a harrowing feat to construct a shelter for hundreds of thousands in this short a time, even with all the technology Zeruertza has.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: And besides, that's hundreds of thousands of lives to support! What do you propose there?!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: And you think waltzing through the tunnel solves that?!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: At least there'll be leeway to begin to do so, provided we pass the most dangerous part of the vein!

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: But if we stay in a temporary shelter, then consider what happens once the Originium seals off our singular passage to any other city.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: We'll have nothing to look forward to but a drawn-out death!

steps.name: Edge Eartheart
steps.text: Ugh, I can see your point there, but I still believe...

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: Of course I understand the risk in my argument! But it's the least worst option we have now!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Y'know... Avdotya.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: If it's not important, can you hold your peace for now, Gavial?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Don't really want to disturb you guys either, but—

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Seeing as the tunnel's blocked...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Our only option left is to fix that Super Convenient Lift-o-Matic #1 Tomimi mentioned, bring all the Durins to the surface and let 'em live with our tribes for a while, right?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I mean, anything wrong with that idea? You guys have been arguing over this forever.

steps.name: Avdotya
steps.text: We head for the... surface?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh, guys... did you never consider that before?
